∀ (p : Nat) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (n : Nat),
  Ne.{1} n 0 →
    Eq.{1} (Nat.card.{0} (Etingof.GL2.PrincipalIndex p n))
      (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} p n) 1)
        (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0}
          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} p n) (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} p n) 1)) 2))

∀ (p : Nat) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (n : Nat),
  Ne.{1} n 0 →
    Exists.{2} fun ι =>
      Exists.{2} fun F =>
        And (∀ (i : ι), CategoryTheory.Simple.{0, 1} (F i))
          (And (∀ (i j : ι), Nonempty.{1} (CategoryTheory.Iso.{0, 1} (F i) (F j)) → Eq.{1} i j)
            (Eq.{1} (Nat.card.{0} ι)
              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} p n) 1)
                (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0}
                  (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} p n) (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} p n) 1))
                  2))))

∀ (p : Nat) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (n : Nat),
  Ne.{1} n 0 →
    ∀ (i j : Etingof.GL2.PrincipalIndex p n),
      Nonempty.{1} (CategoryTheory.Iso.{0, 1} (Etingof.GL2.principalFamily p n i) (Etingof.GL2.principalFamily p n j)) →
        Eq.{1} i j

∀ (p : Nat) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (n : Nat),
  Ne.{1} n 0 → ∀ (i : Etingof.GL2.PrincipalIndex p n), CategoryTheory.Simple.{0, 1} (Etingof.GL2.principalFamily p n i)
